name: Hotel Thierseerhof
beschreibung: Hotel Thierseerhof is idyllically located in the community of Thiersee, nestled between tranquil waters and the striking peaks of the Kaisergebirge. The lakeside setting defines the serene atmosphere of this family-run hotel. Highlights include private lake access with sunbathing lawns as well as a dedicated spa area featuring saunas and relaxation zones. Most guest rooms offer balconies with panoramic views over the lake or mountains. The restaurant serves traditional Tyrolean fare alongside contemporary cuisine crafted from local produce. The location provides an ideal starting point for scenic valley walks and visits to the historic fortress town of Kufstein.
kurzbeschreibung: Family-run lakeside hotel at Lake Thiersee featuring water views, wellness amenities, and regional cuisine.
